mapper.sql: id, owner_id, target_entry_id, parent_id, file_name, mime_type, client_fingerprint, size_bytes, part_size_bytes, total_parts, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, minio_upload_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_session ( id, owner_id, target_entry_id, parent_id, file_name, mime_type, client_fingerprint, size_bytes, part_size_bytes, total_parts, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, minio_upload_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{session.id}, #{session.ownerId}, #{session.targetEntryId}, #{session.parentId}, #{session.fileName}, #{session.mimeType}, #{session.clientFingerprint}, #{session.sizeBytes}, #{session.partSizeBytes}, #{session.totalParts}, #{session.storageBucket}, #{session.storageObjectKey}, #{session.minioUploadId}, #{session.status}, #{session.createdAt}, #{session.updatedAt}, #{session.expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM upload_session WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING', 'COMPLETING') AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upload_session WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING', 'COMPLETING') AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM upload_session WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING', 'COMPLETING') AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_part ( upload_session_id, part_number, etag, sha256, size_bytes ) VALUES ( #{part.uploadSessionId}, #{part.partNumber}, #{part.etag}, #{part.sha256}, #{part.sizeBytes} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE etag = VALUES(etag), sha256 = VALUES(sha256), size_bytes = VALUES(size_bytes), uploaded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT upload_session_id, part_number, etag, sha256, size_bytes, uploaded_at FROM upload_part WHERE upload_session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY part_number
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_session SET status = 'UPLOADING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING')
UPDATE upload_session SET status = 'COMPLETING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING', 'COMPLETING')
UPDATE upload_session SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('COMPLETING', 'COMPLETED')
UPDATE upload_session SET status = 'ABORTED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING', 'COMPLETING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM upload_session WHERE status IN ('INITIATED', 'UPLOADING') AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM upload_session WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'ABORTED') AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 7 DAY) LIMIT 1000
